content_data.project_title: Immersive Character Customization Hub for Fantasy RPG
content_data.project_description: Design and prototype a next-generation character creation interface that enhances player engagement through intuitive visual storytelling and personalization mechanics.
content_data.timeline: 9 months with Phase 1 (months 1-3) for research and concepting, Phase 2 (months 4-6) for prototyping, and Phase 3 (months 7-9) for refinement and testing
objectives: Enhance accessibility features to reach broader European player demographics
Create an emotionally resonant character creation experience that increases player attachment
Establish a scalable design system for future character expansion content
deliverables: User testing reports with iteration recommendations
Interactive high-fidelity prototypes for desktop and mobile platforms
Complete UI/UX design system with component library
Final design handoff package with developer annotations
Motion design specifications and micro-interaction guidelines
technical_specs: Maximum 60fps performance target for all animations
content_data.design_style: Contemporary fantasy aesthetic blending hand-painted textures with clean minimalist interface elements, emphasizing warmth and approachability while maintaining epic scale

memory_deletes.removed_item: Asset delivery in PNG, SVG, and vector formats with organized naming conventions
Figma source files with auto-layout and component variants
